easyNIS: Tidy Workflows for the National Inpatient Sample

Source: R/easyNIS-package.R
easyNIS-package.Rd

Pipe-friendly tools for opening annual Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project National Inpatient Sample Parquet files, flagging diagnosis and procedure codes, looking up user-supplied CCSR codes, adding experimental Elixhauser indicators, preparing designs and weights with the 'survey' package, applying supported HCUP labels, adjusting charges and costs, and reviewing disclosure risks. The Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality provides information on the NIS and how to obtain it at https://hcup-us.ahrq.gov/nisoverview.jsp. Experimental methods and annual-layout assumptions are not independently verified or scientifically approved.

Details

Use nis_open() to open annual National Inpatient Sample (NIS) data as a lazy DuckDB table, nis_flag_dx() or nis_flag_pr() to define a cohort, and nis_design() to prepare a survey design. Use nis_suppress() to review tables for disclosure risk before sharing.

Start with the simulated files from nis_example() and the Getting started guide. For licensed data, see the AHRQ HCUP NIS overview for documentation and access.
